LanguageData.HD_TacticalMultiTargetFire_CommandDesc: Requires burst count 3+ OR ranged cooldown at most 1 second. Engage up to three targets while maintaining movement. Fixed 0.2-second warmup; weapon cooldown is ignored. Shooter accuracy x becomes 3x²−2x³. Hit chance within 7 tiles is doubled, capped at 100%. Cover and armor still apply.
LanguageData.HD_TacticalMultiTargetFire_InvalidTarget: The target is outside the multi-target firing conditions.
